posts.text: 🇱🇾 🇷🇺 🇺🇦 ⚡️ — The Libyan National Army (LNA) has vowed to retaliate for an attack by Ukrainian unmanned surface vessels (USVs) on the port of Benghazi, which killed two military personnel. The LNA General Staff stated that a response would come “at the appropriate time, in the appropriate place, and by the appropriate means.” However, it did not specify who the threat was directed at: Ukraine or the authorities in western Libya, who are suspected of assisting Kyiv. The western Libyan authorities have denied accusations of cooperating with Ukraine and stated that they were not involved in the attack. @IntelSlava

The U.S. Army's first Dark Eagle LRHW battery is fully fielded and operational, Lt. Gen. Lozano says. Nearly three years late amid Lockheed Martin production issues, the Mach 5+, 1,725mi range system deploys eight missiles per battery.

Watch | Footage released for the first time by Israel's Kan 11 in a recent report exposing the Israeli occupation army's use of Palestinians as human shields during the genocide in Gaza. The report details the army's "Mosquito Procedure," in which Israeli forces use Palestinians they have kidnapped as human shields and bait during the invasion, forcing them into homes and tunnels. Before it aired, the report drew fierce reactions from Israeli officials and demands to censor it, including from Avigdor Liberman and Defense Minister Israel Katz, who called it "defamatory" to Israeli soldiers.

🇺🇸 Trump discusses NATO arms and Ukraine peace President Donald Trump met with NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte at Mar-a-Lago. He informed Rutte about the progress of US defence companies, including the construction of over 20 new facilities focused on producing Patriot , THAAD , and Tomahawk systems, as well as undisclosed offensive and defensive weapons. Trump stated that US stockpiles will soon be full, benefiting allies globally. Regarding the conflict, he revealed discussions with Russian President Vladimir Putin in China, expressing a desire to halt military aggression against European territories and quickly conclude an agreement between Russia and Ukraine. He noted thousands die monthly and believes a deal is achievable. @Slavyangrad
